periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Slanted at an approximate 45-degree angle downward toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval/elongated morphology with a horizontal-to-vertical ratio of approximately 1.6:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Marked downward extension or teardrop-like taper below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior edge with a relatively flat profile across the spinal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Significant thickness, covering approximately 25-30% of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation distance, exceeding the total width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly rounded and smooth convex curvature at the top of both pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brown/soil staining on the white pelage of the posterior hindquarters and tail region.
